entity_types.name: Vehicle
entity_types.description: A specific motor vehicle model and year combination subject to safety complaints or recalls, excluding general references to unrelated traffic.

entity_types.name: Component
entity_types.description: A physical automotive part, mechanical assembly, sensor, or software system of a vehicle, excluding non-vehicular objects and road obstacles.

entity_types.name: Problem
entity_types.description: A mechanical defect, component failure, abnormal symptom, unintended behavior, or safety hazard experienced during vehicle operation.

entity_types.name: Recall
entity_types.description: An official safety recall campaign or stop-sale action issued by an automotive manufacturer or regulatory agency, excluding routine maintenance or ordinary repairs.

fact_types.description: Identifies the vehicle part, assembly, or system that exhibits or suffers from the reported problem.
Indicates that one failure, malfunction, or safety hazard directly triggered or resulted in another problem condition.
Identifies the vehicle model that experienced the reported problem or failure condition.
The odometer reading or mileage at which the vehicle failure or problem occurred, expressed as a number with distance units.
The driving speed at which the symptom, malfunction, or abnormal behavior occurs, expressed as a value with speed units.
The duration of time an intermittent or transient failure condition lasts, expressed as a value with time units.
Identifies a subassembly, mechanism, or part that belongs to or operates within a larger vehicle component or system.
Connects a vehicle component to the vehicle model it belongs to, derived from the document context.
Identifies the vehicle part, assembly, or system that is defective and targeted by the safety recall campaign.
Identifies the safety defect, failure symptom, or hazard condition that the recall campaign is intended to rectify.
Identifies the specific vehicle model covered or targeted by the safety recall campaign.
The current or operating odometer reading of the vehicle, expressed as a value with distance units.
